full_judgment:
M. H. Rahman, J.- F.A. No. 90 of 1962 and F. A. No. 53 of 1962 have arisen ref, positively from money Suit No. 8 of 1958 and Money Suit  No. 9 of 1958 dismissed on contest by Mr. A. B. Khan, Subordinate Judge, Dinajur. The two suites were heard together, along with another Money suit from which no appeal has been filed, and disposed of by one judgment. The two appeals have been heard together and will be governed by this judgment. 

 2. The plaintiff-appellant F.A. 90 of 1962, Shafiuddin Khan, filed Money Suit No. 8 of 1958 claiming Rs. 17,004-8.0 for non-delivery of two consignments of cardamom sent on 17.4.57 and 18.4.57 by the East Bengal Railway from Pak Hill to Goalundo. The plaintiff appellant in P.A. No. 53 of 1962, Kalimuddin Ahmed, flied Money suit No. 9 of 1958 claiming Rs. 12,534/- for non-delivery of a consignment of cardamom sent on 19.4.57 from Pak Hilli to Goal undo by the East Bengal Railway. In both the cases when the consignments reached Goal undo the Land Customs Officer detained Inc. goods and reported the matter on 10.6.57 to the higher authority. The Customs Collector fined both the consignors on 20.9.57, but later on 29.10.57 permitted each of them to take delivery of their respective consignments from the Station Master, Goalundo. When the Station Master asked the Head Parcel Clerk on 6-11-57 to effect delivery he was informed by the clerk that the consignments were stolen and the matter was under Police investigation. It was alleged that the consignments were under lock and key in the care of the Head Parcel Clerk and kept under railway guard day and night and the pilferage, if any, had been done by the railway offices during the course of their employ ment and the railway administration was set possible for the loss caused by non-delivery of the goods. Each of the plaintiffs filed claim petition to the Chief Traffic Manager of the Railway on 13-11-57 and later sent on 6-2-38 a notice under section 77 of the Railways Act (Act IX of 1890), hereinafter referred to as the Act and a notice under section 80 of the Code of Civil Procedure was sent on 20.2.58.
